title: Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set
features: Complete interior liner set for Shoei RF-1400 helmet
Protects original padding from wear and tear
Easy installation with included adhesive strips
description:
Engineered to seamlessly integrate into modern helmet speaker cavities, the Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set from Shoei provides riders with uninterrupted acoustic clarity and group connectivity. Built with IP67 Certified Dustproof & Submersion Resistant (All-Season Waterproof Seal), it boasts an installation rating of 2.5 / 10 (Clamp-mount or 3M VHB base with recessed speaker cavity routing).

The Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set represents an indispensable touring and group-ride upgrade from Shoei. Its robust audio tuning and rock-solid weather sealing provide riders with effortless navigation cues and reliable connectivity across arduous highway tours.
